title: Fine-scale statistics for $\mathbb{Q}^n$
summary: We study the distribution of rational points in $\mathbb{R}^n$, with denominators restricted to the interval $[Q-Δ, Q]$, and $Q,Δ\to\infty$ such that $Δ/Q\to 0$. Previous results in the literature, due to Hall and others, were limited to Farey sequences, where the window size $Δ$ is of the same order as $Q$. We prove the convergence of fine-scale statistics in a range of scaling limits and express the limit laws in terms of natural probability measures on the space of affine lattices.
